actual_scope: Prove the exact uniform infinity-norm error for integer-valued rounders equivariant under A_k(x,y)=(x+k*y,-y), on every complete refined grid and on R^2, with one attaining rule.
scope_change_reason: Handoff-first override: Nick Petalas PR5079 Open next question 1 explicitly requests the optimum for A_1. This is a mathematical side theorem with sharp matching bounds, not a duplicate classification replay or a discharge of the original PR4100 caller audit. The same proof closes all integer k without a larger search campaign.
bottleneck_link: Quantifies the least rounding-error allowance compatible with exact carried-frame equivariance; demonstrates unbounded precision cost in an order-two, dimension-two family. Physical reader reachability, paid arithmetic and complete supplier cost remain separate.
stop_rule: Stop after the first sharp proof and bounded exact corroboration. Do not expand to arbitrary finite groups, physical callers, selected replay or a new kappa. Two-hour claim within the donor budget of about four hours.
evidence: PROOF.md gives matching upper/lower bounds for all integer k and refinements m>=2, and R^2. verify.py compares a separately implemented literal box oracle on k=-10..10, m=2..18, checks equivariance, larger attaining witnesses and eight rejecting controls. VALIDATION.md records actual execution and limits. Evidence is author-checked with AI assistance, not human or proof-kernel acceptance.
